steps.content: The helicopter's rumbling and buzzing nauseate you after your long period of confinement. Langley looks completely unbothered and is staring at you with amusement.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Have you read all the documents I gave you?

After leaving the confinement cell, you were immediately taken onto Langley's helicopter and headed off to the DisCity's center. An hour has passed at most. You've been fighting your airsickness while reading the documents, only able to get the gist of them.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Then put them aside. I'll summarize the main points for you. We've arrived.

Outside the window, under the rotor, you've reached the Rust. It's the meandering isolation belt separating the West District Syndicate and Eastside of the DisCity, a dumpster for waste, and an uninhabited area filled with contamination.
There's no water in the Rust, only a river of twisted red light beams gathering and spreading in all directions. Black contamination resembles infernal tentacles, extending outward endlessly.
In the center of the abandoned zone, at the source of the contamination stream, an enormous red luminous ring floats in the air like a gigantic eye, imposing a suffocating pressure around it.
That is the source of the Rust's contamination, the first Black Ring in the DisCity that's lasted for 23 years—BR-001, the <color=#fb9259>Endless Carnival</color>.
The helicopter lands steadily next to the defense zone over a hundred meters away from the luminous ring. Following Langley, you step onto the contaminated soil.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: It's not exactly the first Black Ring. The great explosion of DisSea in N.F. 84 marked the true beginning of all Black Rings, <color=#fb9259>BR-000</color>.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: But this one is indeed the first Black Ring that has erupted in a densely populated area and has not been under full control so far.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: That's right. 23 years ago, the Rust was still the Grace River with a beautiful view, and the Carnival was a favorite amusement park for everyone in the city.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: The day the Black Ring erupted was the third day of the reopening celebration of the DisCity Carnival. Everyone flocked to the park on that day. Guests of all ages came to seek for a paradise of dreams and pleasure.

You look toward the direction Langley is pointing at. Under the red luminous ring, invisible crooked curtains shroud the Carnival. Like a mirage, the vague shapes of several old amusement facilities can still be seen.
Yet the sounds that come from it are not pleasant melodies, but bone-chilling repressed echoes sounding like mad laughter mixed with wails.

At around thirty to fifty meters from the Black Ring, several FAC contamination shields and anti-Black-Ring stations form a ring corresponding to the Black Ring, the blue light striving to resist the red light in the sky.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: After the great explosion of DisSea, the FAC spent five years to get BR-000 under control and slowly led the DisCity out of the trauma. The reopening of the Carnival also served to rebuild citizens' confidence. Those geezers did work hard back in the day.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Unfortunately, no one expected that there would be more than one Black Ring, and not only in DisSea. On the third day after the Carnival reopened, on that most bustling day, BR-001 broke out.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Shield technology was still immature at the time. After several eruptions, the FAC could only give up the Grace River altogether and utilize the valley terrain to block contamination. In time, this place has become what it is now.
Black thorns, floating debris, and heaps of filthy waste keep expanding outward. Between the remains of the badly decayed facilities, the once gleeful cartoon images can still be made out.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Alright, that's the end of my introduction. Be careful, even today, the Carnival is still a very popular destination.
From the depths of the Rust come strange noise, heavy panting, low cries, and screams... As if responding to them, the Black Ring begins shuddering, illuminating the crooked figures staggering near.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: The... Carnival... Let me into... the Car...nival...

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Let me...in!! Let me in...!!
Corruptors and soulless scavengers are swarming near from all directions. As if lured in by something, they're all rushing toward the Black Ring urgently, charging at you.

Before you can use your power, Langley presses down your hand with her gun. At the same moment, an enormous shadow suddenly appears before you. You hear a familiar voice that's been missing for days...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stay away from him!
Roaring, the Nightmare rips apart the Corruptor approaching you. Hecate dashes before you. Not far away, Hella knocks a scavenger out with her pipe.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Don't exhaust yourself so soon. If I could fish you out from that place, of course I could fish out your subordinates from wherever they were too.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Remember, you're a senior officer. Ensuring your own safety is your responsibility to them.

steps.speaker: Intelligence Agent
steps.content: Madam! The Corruptors are attacking the Anti-Black Ring Base Station. The FAC's reinforcements cannot arrive in time as they're still cleaning up the remains of the Black Ring in Keylan Square. The Corruptors there have taken up too much of our forces.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: We'll take this chance and make them owe us a favor then. ${PlayerName}, are you coming?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Think of it as a show. I'll make sure to pile it on in the report to help you gain a few more points from those stubborn geezers in the FAC.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't get overprotective. I'm not that weak.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'll prove to you that we're qualified to take the Black Rings head on.
